search.query: | mstats avg("sensors.*core*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
| mstats avg("sensors.*temp*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
| mstats avg("sensors.*fan*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("sensors.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("sensors.*vcore*","sensors.*vdd*","sensors.*vin*","sensors.*12v*","sensors.*3v*","sensors.*5v*","sensors.*bat*","sensors.*_in*","sensors.*vsoc*","sensors.*mem*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("sensors.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("sensors.*watt*","sensors.*power*","sensors.*psu*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="sensors.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
